column4: Set up a new Python project whose make targets run inside Docker, with the container image kept in sync between local dev and CI. What is the house pattern for this? Describe it; do not create the project.
I want to add the `ripgrep` system package so it gets installed on Linux. Where do I make that change, and what else must I not forget?
I want to add a new MCP server so every AI harness picks it up. Where is it declared, and where must the API token NOT go?
I want to add a new pi agent package that carries its own config. What do I need to declare, and what is the trap?
How does agent knowledge get resolved and delivered to the different harnesses in this repo, and what are the rules that are easy to break?
What is the capital of Portugal?
